top_signals.title: 'Root cause’ of nationwide ground stop is unknown, FAA says
top_signals.summary: Routers and networking equipment may be involved in the problems that led to the ground stop, but a definitive cause has not been established, officials said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
